newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Savino first half pre-tax slips.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Savino first half pre-tax slips.

text.p: Italian international haulage company Savino Del Bene posted a first half pre-tax profit of 4.7 billion lire, down from 5.6 billion a year earlier.
The result was after amortizations and provisions of some five billion lire, the company said in a statement.
Consolidated turnover was 173.2 billion lire, against 172.9 billion a year earlier, while gross operating profit fell to 8.6 billion lire from 9.6 billion.
The company, quoted on the Milan stock exchange since February, said it had reduced its net debt to 8.5 billion lire at end-June from 16.8 billion a year earlier.
